checks.note: conserved exactly by streaming, so the bound is single precision and not physics: a population is read, multiplied and written once a step in float32, and 40 steps of that accumulate about sqrt(steps)*eps = 1e-6, which is what this measures. The bound is 1e-5 for that reason and would be 1e-14 in double precision. The inlet/outlet box this case also runs drifts about a percent and is supposed to
